title: laraplate-edge-config/1
description: The configuration document of the laraplate-edge agent: inputs reading machines, outputs sending laraplate-machine/1 messages, and plugins. Secrets appear only as secret:// references. Published by laraplate-edge; this schema describes the full format, and a build may still refuse parts it does not provide (reported as "not available in this build").

version.description: Increases with every published document; a document older than the applied one is refused. Absent counts as 0.

id.description: Component id, unique within its list. An output id names a buffer directory.

duration.description: A positive duration such as 500ms, 2s, 1m or 1h30m.

size.description: A size in bytes with a binary unit, such as 512KiB, 16MiB or 1GiB.

secretRef.description: A secret reference: secret://env/NAME, secret://file/PATH or secret://keystore/NAME. A plain value is refused.

driver.description: A built-in driver or a plugin-provided one written plugin:<plugin id>.

outputType.description: A built-in output type or a plugin-provided one written plugin:<plugin id>.

httpURL.description: The Laraplate base URL: https, or http for a loopback host only.

deviceName.description: A device name, used in messages and in routes (device/signal), so it holds no /.

signalName.description: A signal name, used in messages and in routes (device/signal), so it holds no /.

transforms.description: A transform chain, applied in order.

priority.description: The buffer priority class. Bulk records are evicted first when the buffer is full.

connection.description: Driver connection settings, not interpreted by the schema. Any key equal to or ending with password, token, secret or api_key, in any letter case and at any depth, must hold a secret reference.

death_tolerance.description: How long without a successful read before the input reports its devices dead.

point.description: One signal read from the machine. The pair (device, signal) is unique across all inputs.

type.description: The decoding type of the address. bool gives a boolean signal, string a string signal, every other type (and none) a number.

read.description: subscribe, event, a polling interval, or subscribe with its settings.

readSubscribe.description: The settings of a point read by subscription. A driver that does not subscribe ignores them; a driver that does uses what its protocol has room for.

sampling.description: How often the source samples the value; absent means the source's own publishing interval.

queue.description: How many values the source queues between two publications; absent means the driver's default.

readDeadband.description: The change a value needs to be reported: a non-negative number (absolute), or a percentage up to 100 ("5%") of the range the source reports for the value.

transform.description: One step of the transform chain: an object with a single key naming a transform of the catalogue, whose value holds the transform's parameters.

transformScale.description: scale: multiplies a number by this factor; produces a float.

transformOffset.description: offset: adds this amount to a number; produces a float.

transformRound.description: round: rounds a float half away from zero to this many decimals; an integer passes unchanged.

transformBit.description: bit: extracts the bit at this index (0 is the least significant) of an integer; produces a boolean.

transformBcd.description: bcd: decodes an integer written in binary-coded decimal; a nibble above 9 is a runtime error.

transformMap.description: map: looks the value, rendered as text, up in table. The table values and the default share one kind (integers and floats together are floats), which the step produces; the table may be empty only with a default. A missing key with no default is a runtime error.

transformValidRange.description: valid_range: a number outside [min, max] keeps its value with quality bad. At least one bound; min must not exceed max (checked by the agent).

transformDeadband.description: deadband: sends a number when it moved from the last sent value by at least this absolute amount, or by this percentage of the last sent value ("5%"), or when its quality changed. The first value always passes.

transformHeartbeat.description: heartbeat: resends the last value with the current time when nothing left the step for this positive duration. It resends what last left the step, so after a bad sample it resends bad.

transformMinInterval.description: min_interval: the first sample of a quiet period passes at once; then at most one sample per positive interval: the latest of the window, with its own timestamp, at the window's end. A bad sample passes at once and drops the held one.

transformDebounce.description: debounce: sends a value only after it stayed unchanged for this positive duration, with the timestamp of the change. A bad sample cancels the pending value and forgets the last sent one.

transformEdgeCounter.description: edge_counter: the cumulative count of the edges of a boolean, persisted across restarts; produces an integer. The first sample after a start emits the current count as a baseline.

transformDerivative.description: derivative: the change per second of a number over the sample timestamps; produces a float.

transformTrim.description: trim: removes the white space around a string.

transformRegexExtract.description: regex_extract: the capture group (default 1) of an RE2 pattern over a string, converted to the kind named by as (default string). The pattern must compile and hold the group (checked by the agent). No match or a failed conversion is a runtime error.

derived.description: A signal computed by a CEL expression over the device's other signals; level-1 transforms may follow the expression.

url.description: Where the output sends; its form depends on the output type.

route.description: Which samples the output receives: patterns matched against device/signal; * alone matches everything and a pattern without / means device/*.

max_size.description: At least 32MiB, two segments of 16 MiB (checked by the agent's rules, not expressible on a size string).

min_free_percent.description: The share of the disk kept free, above 0 (0 would mean the buffer default).

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the plugin binary.

manifest_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the plugin.json file next to the binary.

max_memory.description: The most memory the plugin process may use, above it the agent restarts it. Omitted: no limit.
